{{Top|ca|leg}}
'''Imperial crans''' were a unit of measurement which existed during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and were sometimes used when discussing amounts of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. Twelve Imperial crans of [[Ubuuga caviar]] were served at the [[Marriage/Legends|wedding]] feast of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo]] and his bride [[Anachro]] the [[H'uun]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]]. The feast, including the caviar, was paid for by [[Orko]] the H'uun, Anachro's [[Parent/Legends|father]].<ref name="BF:WTFLS">''[[Boba Fett: When the Fat Lady Swings]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Imperial crans were first mentioned in ''[[Boba Fett: When the Fat Lady Swings]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] written by [[John Wagner]] and published in [[1996]]. The comic book does not state what Imperial crans are a measurement of.<ref name="BF:WTFLS" />
